name: PlantRenderDescription + RendererProfile Foundation
purpose: Introduce a deterministic derived PlantRenderDescription and renderer-profile abstraction so visual complexity, assets and LOD can evolve independently of GrowthGraph, genome and ecology truth.
truth_invariants: renderer profile and LOD never modify GrowthGraph
profile changes never modify genome, phenotype, resource, selection or lifecycle truth
TREE/BUSH/GRASS are not renderer or canonical ecology classes
same GrowthGraph deterministically rebuilds the same PlantRenderDescription
all renderer profiles consume the same PlantRenderDescription

local_core_preflight.platform: Godot 4.7.1 stable double Linux isolated PH5 core fixture
local_core_preflight.scope: synthetic GrowthGraph fixture used only to prove GDScript syntax, deterministic profile/materialization contracts and visual-lab scene smoke before publishing

windows_gate.parent_ph4: require focused 718 + restart 5 exact accepted hashes
windows_gate.ph5_focused: run against all seven accepted PH2 environment-coupled GrowthGraphs
windows_gate.restart: require focused and fresh-process reference description/profile matrix/full materialization hashes to match
windows_gate.graphical: user cycles environments and all six profiles and confirms visibly distinct coherent representations with no truth-hash changes

scope_boundary: PH5-S1 is the representation contract and diagnostic materialization foundation. It does not yet claim production 3D branch mesh generation, GPU foliage instancing, production canopy clustering or production impostor baking.
next_after_acceptance: ECO.PH5-S2 3D Tapered Branch Tubes + Instanced Foliage
unrelated_blocker_retained: PH3C_FULL_POOL_COMPACT_DOMINANCE remains required before unconstrained morphology mutation/evolution; it does not block renderer research.
